content.bridge_context: Following our study of basic needs like food and water, we look at clothes and the fascinating journey from raw fiber to finished fabric.

units.title: Natural vs Synthetic Fibers
units.explanation: Natural fibers come from plants (cotton, jute) and animals (wool, silk). Synthetic fibers are man-made (nylon, polyester).
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the source. / स्रोत की पहचान करें।

units.title: Steps in Cloth Making
units.explanation: The process includes spinning (fiber to yarn), weaving (yarn to fabric), and dyeing/printing.
units.dual_language_instruction: List the steps. / चरणों की सूची बनाएं।
